reply.text:
Glad it helped, but I should correct my earlier reply. I guessed at the cause and the runner without seeing your config or the test output, and I stated the diagnosis more firmly than I'd earned.

Ten clean runs don't prove the fix. At a 1-in-5 failure rate, ten passes in a row happen about 11% of the time by luck alone. To confirm, run the full suite 20 to 30 times with the new setting and count failures. If you still see any, the cause is something else, such as test-order dependence or a shared fixture or temp file.
